How should I read this?

The PM2.5 measurement represents the concentration of fine particles in the air. Higher values generally indicate poorer air quality. The Edge AI model uses sensor information to estimate future conditions.

Air Quality Guide

Four Air Quality Levels

Simple categories to help you understand the forecast quickly.

Very Good

Excellent air quality. Outdoor activities are comfortable for most people.

Good

Safe for most people. Normal outdoor activities are fine.

Moderate

Sensitive groups should take care outdoors.

Unhealthy

Reduce prolonged outdoor activity and take care.

How AeroSense works

Sensors continuously collect PM2.5, temperature, humidity, and atmospheric pressure. These measurements are sent to the system, where the Edge AI model analyzes the latest conditions and produces an air-quality prediction. The forecast is shown as an easy-to-understand category rather than only raw numbers.
